note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of research date. Tooling limitation: the DuckDuckGo/searx search backend was down (connection refused) for the whole session; only Bing HTML results were reachable, and Bing returned the same generic 10-result set for every query variant (including site:indiankanoon.org and court/insolvency/income-tax queries), so no adverse-record search could be executed reliably. Direct registry access failed: ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403, Tofler search returned 404. OFAC SDN/UN/EU/UK/BIS consolidated lists could not be queried (no working sanctions-search endpoint reachable). Therefore sanctions_hit, court_cases, rating, news_risk and rf_supply are all null = NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED IN THIS PASS, not evidence of absence. What was actually observed: (1) The only Indian entity matching the name is 'Chempure Private Limited', founded 1943, a distributor/supplier of speciality research chemicals, with address #89A-4, 1st Main, 3rd Cross, N.S. Palya Industrial Area, Bangalore 560076, India, phone +91 (80) 6910 6910 (source: https://chempure.in, read directly). This contradicts the batch metadata on two points: state_claimed 'Maharashtra' (site address is Karnataka) and industry_claimed 'IT и электроника' (actual business is laboratory/speciality chemicals distribution, incl. electronic-grade chemicals as one product line). Flagging for the identity/HS team, not a rejection ground. (2) No sanctions, court, regulator or negative-news item about this entity appeared in any reachable result set. (3) No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS found; the site describes customers as academic institutions, industrial R&D labs, government R&D labs and microelectronics/petrochemical majors, with no export destinations or Russia/CIS mentions. (4) No credit rating found in public sources. (5) Note the name collision risk: 'Chempure' is also used by unrelated firms in the USA (chempurebrand.com, chempure.com), South Africa (chempure.co.za) and Germany (chempur.de) — none of these are the Indian entity and none should be attributed to it. Per project rules, no rejection is proposed: nothing indicates the legal entity is non-existent, liquidated or bankrupt. Recommend a re-run of sanctions (OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS) and Indian court (eCourts/NCLT/Indian Kanoon) checks once search tooling is restored.
